text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
La-la-laaa♪ ...All right, I think that 
finishes cleaning the floor.

text_block_list.name: Athletic Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
*cough*. Man, it really is dusty in 
here... Wait, is that Desire-san? Why are 
you cleaning here—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I'm in the middle of a trial right now. 
Now then, next up is the equipment—

text_block_list.name: Athletic Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Hae? ...Wait, you're cleaning up 
everything?! There's so much stuff here, 
though!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Because no one else wants to do it. 
Which means... it is a trial bestowed upon 
this Saint.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ...Heave-ho~, heave-ho~.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, Bright-san. Why are you wiping 
down the desk all by yourself?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"The desk was looking pretty dirty~. So I 
figured I might as well clean the whole 
thing~."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
However, it doesn't look like I'll be 
finishing anytime soon~. I really am such 
a slowpoke, after all.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Goodness, you're doing this all on your 
own?! In that case... please let me help 
you too!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Fuha~... It's another lovely day today. 
The flowers in the flowerbed look like 
they're enjoying it too.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Oh, huh? ...I wonder whose keychain this 
is.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...A keychain of unknown origin. Finding 
its owner must be my trial as well—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, Lala-san. I will carry that...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes?

text_block_list.name: Desire's Friend
text_block_list.text:
Thanks a bunch for helping carry the 
luggage! Man, doing it alone was just way 
too tough!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Not at all. It was simply a trial placed 
before me, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Desire's Friend
text_block_list.text:
You say that, but everyone's talking about 
how you've been helping so many people!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, saying I'm a hot topic... 
............Oh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...Hrrrm, what to do about this~

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Grrr... The vegetables didn't grow well at 
all, huh~...

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, I have to till the entire field all 
over again~...? *sigh*~

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...Your heart seems clouded. Let me share 
in bearing that pain with you.

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Hae?! Desire-san?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, hold on! Are you really sure you 
should agree to help out that fast, 
Desire!?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Of course. This is yet another trial— if 
so, as a saint, I shall simply overcome 
it!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
... There's really no end in sight, is 
there...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Well, I mean, it is all the land around 
here~ Seriously, isn't it just way too 
huge?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Even you didn't think it'd go this far, 
did you, Desire?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Indeed. ...Still, fufu. It makes me happy.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"The greater the trial, the more my heart 
dances! ...Fufu, fufufu!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...D-Desire?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu, oh that Desire-san, helping people 
out again.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Oh...? Lala-san... and Bright-san too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I heard voices on my way back from the 
gym, so I came to check it out~. And then—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Are you in a bit of a pickle? We can help 
out too, Desire-san.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
My goodness! Lala, Bright, are you sure 
about this?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes. And I really wanted to repay Lady 
Desire, too~

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Right, right. It feels a bit embarrassing 
if I'm always on the receiving end of 
kindness. What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Thank you... What profound benevolence. I 
must offer thanks for this day, blessed to 
have witnessed such radiance.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Then—together, unto the trial!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On my way back to the dorm, I heard a 
familiar voice coming from the fields, so 
I stopped by to check it out—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Phewwww, done and done! Who would've 
thought we'd actually pull it off!

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much! It's really all thanks 
to everyone...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
No~... And besides, this is all thanks to 
Lady Desire.
